top_signals.title: Wall Street Delivers Harsh Verdict on Warsh Fed
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has vowed to reestablish the central bank's reputation as an inflation fighter. But on Wednesday he had to defend why the bank has held rates steady yet again. Some investors say it's time for Warsh to be a little more clear on the Fed's direction. Jonnelle Marte explains why  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UK’s FCA to Publish Daily Stock-Trading Data Starting Friday
top_signals.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority, the UK’s markets regulator, plans to publish a daily summary of trading in the country’s shares starting Friday, part of its effort to increase transparency, according to people familiar with the matter.
